en: A black-and-white rural scene showing several traditional wooden farmhouses and outbuildings with pitched roofs, set at the edge of fields and bordered by trees and forest in the background. At the top center of the image is the printed place name "Elverum", suggesting the view is of a farm or settlement near Elverum. The overall style and printing resemble an early 20th‑century picture postcard.
